notes: fix: Emulator setup could get stuck half-installed with no way to retry - there are now Repair and Clear buttons, and DropX detects an unfinished device image
new: Repair setup - re-runs the device setup and fixes only what is missing
new: Clear install - delete the emulators and start fresh (keeps the large one-time download)
fix: DropX now checks your PC can run an emulator BEFORE the 1.5GB download, and tells you exactly what to change
fix: A device that never finished setup no longer launches unspoofed - it stops and tells you to repair
perf: A device with no root no longer spends 20+ minutes retrying before giving up
fix: DropX could not start for some fresh downloads - Windows was blocking the files; DropX now unblocks its own files
new: Whatnot emulator farm - run bot instances on your PC with no phone required
perf: Emulators use far less CPU - video is blocked on both of Whatnot's video systems
fix: Emulator no longer switches to the stream it is already watching
fix: Streamer rotation keeps your top streamer in the pool instead of dropping it
fix: A streamer off cooldown gets a full set of chances, and a stream that comes back live rejoins right away
new: Emulators self-check that video stays blocked and repair it automatically
new: Per-emulator health logs so a problem on your PC can be diagnosed from the log alone
new: Target auto-buy runs end to end - stock watch, add to cart, and checkout without a browser window
new: Per-item maximum buy price so auto-buy never overpays on a drop
